short: Gregor Mendel, pioneer of the science of heredity.
note: Gregor Mendel (1822–1884), the Augustinian monk whose experiments with pea plants established basic patterns of inheritance. His results were presented in 1865.

sources.label: National Human Genome Research Institute · Gregor Mendel

short: Charles Darwin, naturalist and theorist of evolution.
note: Charles Darwin (1809–1882), British naturalist whose voyage aboard HMS Beagle helped shape his later work on evolution by natural selection.

short: A self-moving mechanism or artificial figure.
note: A self-moving mechanism or artificial figure. Automata is the Greek-derived plural.

short: A resin mixture that sets when heated.
note: A dispersion of resin in a liquid plasticizer, forming a paste or liquid that gels on heating.
